results.trackName: Prayer Book 8 - Knowing God - Intimacy Revelation and Wisdom Prayer
results.description: The greatest thing in life is to know God. Many believers want to go deeper but do not know how. Dag Heward-Mills has outlined thirty-four deep and heartfelt prayer topics to help you draw close to God and hear His voice. Pray for every veil to be removed from your eyes. Pray to see His glory and to receive the wisdom that brings riches and honour. Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you!
